crosshair — ANNOTATE pointer op

• Data kinds: image2d → image2d

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.crosshair(img, xy, color='emphasis', width=1, gap=6, extent=None, scheme='okabe_ito', style=None) (to call the implementation directly, import annotate; annotate.crosshair(img, xy, color='emphasis', width=1, gap=6, extent=None, scheme='okabe_ito', style=None); from the registry, opsannotate.get("crosshair"))

Usage

The crossing lines of a cut plane (used in MPR). A gap keeps the centre clear so it hides nothing.

Parameters

xy : (x, y)

Intersection point.

gap : int

Radius left empty at the centre [px] (0 for lines running all the way through).

extent : int or None

Arm length from the centre [px]. If None, to the edge of the image.

Raises

ValueError

intersection outside the image, negative gap/extent.
